summary: End-to-end testing of the anti-chargeback delivery confirmation feature. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass covering ship (422 without tracking), carrier-delivered (400/403/200 + deadline ~3d + source=seller + buyer notification), pending confirmations list, confirm-received (delivered + payout release_at ~2d + hold_reason=delivered + seller notif + second-call 400 + non-buyer 403), not-received (payout frozen release_at=null + hold_reason=not_received + auto-opened dispute with tracking_proof + second-call 400 + seller notif), admin dispute reject (order back to delivered + payout release_at restored ~2d + hold_reason=dispute_rejected), and legacy /mark-delivered from both shipped and carrier_delivered. Frontend Playwright verified un-dismissable modal appears on / and /explore for the seeded demo collector, Escape and backdrop click are blocked, tracking + deadline testids render, not-received-confirm-step + back navigation works, and mobile 390px shows no horizontal overflow. Admin /admin Disputes tab correctly renders the tracking-proof-{id} block including 'auto-opened via not-received prompt · payout frozen' badge for the auto-opened not_received dispute.

issues: Order id prefix rendering as '#order_fb' (from `#${order.id.slice(0,8)}`) reads awkwardly because seeded ids are already prefixed with 'order_'. Cosmetic only — consider stripping known prefixes before slicing.

critical_code_review_comments: delivery.py mark_carrier_delivered: web-push best-effort try/except is fine, but the Resend email send has no try/except — if send_email raises in preview, the API call will 500. Wrap in try/except like _push.
delivery.py buyer_not_received: does not check refunded before freezing; the API layer does check refunded (buyer_not_received route rejects with 400), so covered. Fine.
orders.py ship: only allows transition from 'pending' — no support for re-shipping after a not_received/dispute rejected. Acceptable for MVP but flag if reshipping is a future requirement.
DeliveryConfirmModal only polls /orders/confirmations/pending on route change + 60s interval; no websocket push. Acceptable but a fresh carrier_delivered event may take up to 60s to appear.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md (unchanged). Admin monster@houseofmonster.com / MonsterAdmin2026!; demo.collector@artcorestudio.net / DemoCollector2026!; demo.artist@artcorestudio.net / DemoArtist2026!.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted several TEST_-prefixed orders/disputes/users during pytest and Playwright. All cleaned up (1 order, 1 dispute, 4 notifs, 14 users deleted at end). Seeded 'order_fb53a5e1' left in carrier_delivered state as instructed — not consumed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_delivery_confirmation.py — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_delivery_confirmation.py -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini injects xdist which fights the ordered fixture pattern). Frontend modal is covered visually via Playwright but the confirm-received / not-received-submit paths were NOT clicked on the demo collector's real order to preserve it for future testers. Fresh orders are the safe way to exercise those buttons.
